note.fr: Un entretien en ligne est requis : préparez votre motivation et votre niveau d'anglais. Certains programmes comportent aussi un test (souvent en mathématiques niveau lycée).
note.en: An online interview is required: prepare your motivation and English skills. Some programmes also include a test (often high-school-level mathematics).

evidence.quote: Online Interview and Test: If your application meets the initial requirements, you will be invited for an online interview.

note.fr: Frais à prévoir : frais de dossier 200 EUR et, le cas échéant, frais de dortoir 750 EUR, à payer avec la première année de frais de scolarité.
note.en: Fees to plan for: application fee EUR 200 and, if applicable, dormitory fee EUR 750, payable with the first year's tuition fee.

evidence.quote: you will need to pay the first year's tuition fee and other applicable fees (e.g., application fee of EUR 200, and dormitory fee of EUR 750).

notes: No dedicated page for this programme was supplied; duration (8 semesters -> 4 years) and tuition (EUR 3,000 per semester for self-financed students) come from the institution's tuition table on the Tuition fees and Refund Policy page. No deadline for a non-EU/international applicant is stated with a year: the '30 July' date on the tuition page is programme-specific (new Mechanical Engineering BSc) and has no year, so no intake was recorded. No language or subject admission requirement for this programme is stated on the supplied pages.
